Peterson Pressure Washing LI was founded by Matthew Peterson, a dad who takes pride in home maintenance. He learned first hand how these services can completely change the appearance of a home and wanted to share his knowledge & passion with others. Peterson Pressure Washing LI offers a variety of services that can restore/preserve your home's natural beauty, maintain its value, and when done annually helps ensure you get the most out of your home for years to home. ​ Our goal is to come together to form a truly amazing pressure washing company that our community is proud of. Peterson Pressure washing LI goes above and beyond to ensure you’re completely satisfied and continue to work with us in the future.
